# sidecar.GaussianPSF { #healpyxel.sidecar.GaussianPSF }

```python
sidecar.GaussianPSF(sigma=None)
```

2D Gaussian Point Spread Function centered at (0,0).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type          | Description                                                                                                                                             | Default   |
|--------|---------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| sigma  | float or None | Standard deviation of the Gaussian kernel in the same units as the input coordinates (e.g., degrees). If None, must be set before calling the instance. | `None`    |
